# Security

Report a vulnerability in Jason — in the runtime attached to a release, in a plugin, in a skill or in the install
scripts — privately, to **support@reply.io**. Say which version you ran (`jason --version`), on which platform, and
what you saw. Please do not put the details anywhere public.

A fix ships as a release, through this repository like every other change, and its notes say what it fixed once it is
out.
